Execution audit: each concept uses one unrotated, uncropped source photograph, no duplicated product, no macro plates, no diptych; primitive budgets hold (Emblem Field: rect+ellipse+silhouette+line = 4; Night Monument: horizon band+glow ellipse = 2; Winter Horizon: sky field+horizon band+snow disc+glow = 4; Certificate Page: 0 primitives + 1 line); no relighting is claimed (dark/pale environments sit behind the opaque silhouette and the cutout keeps its source key); no new slogans, model numbers, certifications or gemstone grades are invented, and the empty price is preserved. Dial grammar (Roman indices, double-digit date under XII, small-seconds subdial printed РОССИЯ/КВАРЦ, two crowns) is only referenced descriptively, never altered.
